method: Real Chromium computed foreground versus actual rendered background pixels. Flat native button/input backgrounds are independently checked against the pixel at upper centre inside the control; transparent light text uses the brightest sampled surrounding background. Keyboard focus/selected rings use actual adjacent outside pixels. Thresholds remain normal text 4.5 and non-text/focus 3. Bounded checks, not a WCAG certification.
